title: Resolution declaring June 18 as Autistic Pride Day
summary: This resolution would have the City Council declare June 18 as Autistic Pride Day in New York City. It cites CDC data showing autism spectrum disorder now affects about 1 in 31 eight-year-olds nationally, and notes local advocacy groups like Autistic Adults NYC that support the autistic community. The day originated in 2005 and is marked worldwide to celebrate neurodiversity and self-determination.
